AURORA-12
A fully synthetic benchmark for evidence-linked poster generation
content.affiliations: Fictional Methods Laboratory · Example Research Campus · no real authors or institutions

content.question: Can a realistic multi-cohort manuscript exercise evidence-linked poster generation without redistributing a real paper or implying biomedical evidence?
content.datasets:
Discovery n=620 · Internal validation n=310
External simulation A n=186 · External simulation B n=124
All values are authored fixtures; no participant, specimen, institution, registry or external dataset exists.
dataset_bullets: External A n=186 · External B n=124

content.takeaway_subtitle: Synthetic baseline: 0.66 and 0.65 · software fixture, not clinical validation
content.validation:
• External calibration slopes were 0.97 and 0.95.
• External absolute errors were 0.031 and 0.038.
• Aggregate coefficient-sign stability was 92% across 500 resamples.
• The most severe pre-specified shift reduced C-index by 0.04.
content.performance_strip: AURORA-12 vs baseline C-index · Discovery 0.78 vs 0.68 · Internal 0.76 vs 0.67 · External A 0.75 vs 0.66 · External B 0.74 vs 0.65
content.conclusion: AURORA-12 is a controlled, rights-safe fixture for testing evidence-linked scientific communication. It supports no inference about real biology, prognosis, treatment or clinical utility. Every number, cohort, feature, author and institution is fictional.
conclusion_bullets: No biological, prognostic or clinical inference
All cohorts, values and identities are fictional
